item.title: Diary: July 2021 (first ten days). Hospitalisation and the first week back home
item.description: 3 July - My 16 hours at the Accidents and Emergencies department Things escalated in the past 24 hours. My leg pain, initially caused by a tendonitis, has been increasing for a week now, despite using crunches. The pain weirdly shifted from the foot to the lower leg. My physiotherapist, with whom I had booked a session for Friday afternoon, immediately detected that something is not right and arranged an urgent appointment with the orthopaedic.
